title.narrative: UNICEF secured government commitment to implement creches/childcare as integral to women empowerment, initiating a national disability inclusion study, launching the SETU-Social Protection coalition, strengthening SP4Nutrition-CoP platform, and accelerating cash-grants to women in many states. Focus was on evidence generation, stakeholder dialogues, technical assistance, multi-sectoral convergence, and UN-wide collaboration. Multi-state studies on girl-child cash transfers across 8 states, maternity benefits in 5 states, the Rural Employment Guarantee Scheme in 4 states and G20 deliberations on the care economy, community-based delivery models, enhanced government commitment to inclusive, child-focused, gender-transformative, and adaptive social protection, helped achieve broader coverage and a more inclusive system.
